Luidia sarsii africana
A starfish taxon in the family Luidiidae, order Paxillosida, class Asteroidea, phylum Echinodermata; common name Legs break easily starfish; arms break off easily, distinct spines on aboral margin, long flexible flattened tapering arms, usually five; colour brown to dark pink; size up to 150 mm diameter; distribution Southern African endemic along West and South Coasts of South Africa to Port Elizabeth at 54-360+ m depth; similar to Astropecten polyacanthus and Astropecten exilis but with more flattened broader arms and easy arm breakage.

Echinodermata
Phylum containing starfish such as Luidia sarsii africana.

Asteroidea
Class of starfish that includes Luidia sarsii africana.

Paxillosida
Order of starfish that includes Luidia sarsii africana.

Luidiidae
Family of starfish that includes Luidia sarsii africana.

Luidia
Genus of starfish that includes Luidia sarsii africana.

Astropecten polyacanthus
A starfish species similar to Luidia sarsii africana.

Astropecten exilis
A starfish species similar to Luidia sarsii africana.

Arms
Long, flexible, flattened, tapering, strap-like appendages of Luidia sarsii africana, usually five in number and capable of breaking off easily from the central disc.

Central disc
Central part of Luidia sarsii africana from which the arms can break off easily.

Aboral margin edge
Edge on the aboral side of Luidia sarsii africana where distinct spines protrude.

Spines
Distinct spines protruding from the aboral margin edge of Luidia sarsii africana.

Luidia sarsii africana Distribution
Southern African endemic distribution of Luidia sarsii africana along the West and South Coasts of South Africa to Port Elizabeth at depths of 54 to 360+ meters.

Starfishes of the Atlantic
Reference document cited for information on Luidia sarsii africana, authored by Clark AM and Downey ME, 1992.
